name: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) - Maxim Makhankov, Heilpraktiker für Psychotherapie
description: Therapy, for me, is a shared journey. I see my role as a witness and companion in your process of change. Drawing from cognitive-behavioral, humanistic, and psychodynamic traditions, I adapt my approach to fit your individual needs. My work is informed by self-compassion, radical acceptance, and mindfulness-based techniques. I believe therapy should be both structured and flexible. Some clients seek guidance and practical tools; others need a space to be heard and understood without pressure. I adjust my role based on your needs — whether that means taking an active, structured approach or creating a reflective space for exploration.

offers.name: Support for relationships, emotional overwhelm, and self-discovery

faq.question: In welchen Sprachen wird die Therapie angeboten?
faq.answer: Die Therapie kann auf Englisch, Deutsch oder Russisch durchgeführt werden.
